lines.subject_line: Inish Pharmacy and Diablo Sugar Free
lines.personal_line: Your online pharmacy already delivers sugar free sweets nationwide from your Donegal base. Adding sugar free chocolate, biscuits and spreads alongside them could be a strong next step for growth, and we would value a partnership with your team.

Your team supplies international foods to independent retailers, supermarkets and caterers across Ireland and Northern Ireland. Our sugar free range could give those customers a new confectionery category to stock alongside the rest of your offer.

lines.subject_line: Sugar free range for Inish Pharmacy
lines.personal_line: Your online shop already gives customers a choice of sugar free sweets. Our range of sugar free chocolate, biscuits, wafers and spreads could round out that section with categories you do not list yet.
